description: Raw and Load-Normalised Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) Datasets for Provincial Route P21 (Km0.000 - Km36.207), KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This repository contains raw and load-normalised Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) datasets collected on Provincial Route P21 (Km0.000 - Km36.207) in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Coverage: South Africa. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Civil Engineering, FOS: Civil engineering, Pavement Evaluation. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
